findings.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Prior-version selection and post-release updates mishandle patched or older maintained release lines.
3 open findings - [Prevent older patch releases from regressing the 2.x baseline](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20542#discussion_r4250582534) · New - [Select the latest full version for release comparisons](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20542#discussion_r4250582603) · New - [Use the latest patch when determining the previous minor range](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20542#discussion_r4250582646) · New
What changed in this PR Adds release and maintenance tooling for a long-lived `2.x` development branch alongside `main`. **Changes:** - Makes release preparation, notes, and post-release updates branch-aware. - Extends CI, Renovate, backports, and snapshots to `2.x`. - Adds release configuration logic and workflow tests. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `RELEASING.md` | Documents the dual release streams. | | `.github/​workflows/​zizmor.yml` | Scans pushes to `2.x`. | | `.github/​workflows/​release.yml` | Routes releases and follow-up updates by stream. | | `.github/​workflows/​prepare-release-branch.yml` | Prepares releases from either development branch. | | `.github/​workflows/​gradle-wrapper-validation.yml` | Validates `2.x` pushes. | | `.github/​workflows/​draft-release-notes.yml` | Targets notes at the selected branch. | | `.github/​workflows/​codeql.yml` | Adds `2.x` security analysis. | | `.github/​workflows/​build.yml` | Builds `2.x` pushes. | | `.github/​workflows/​build-common.yml` | Runs release-tooling tests. | | `.github/​workflows/​backport.yml` | Permits backports directly to `2.x`. | | `.github/​workflows/​auto-license-report.yml` | Safely skips absent license patches. | | `.github/​scripts/​update-changelog-for-release.sh` | Generalizes development-branch wording. | | `.github/​scripts/​test_release_config.py` | Tests release routing and workflows. | | `.github/​scripts/​release-config.py` | Centralizes stream and version selection. | | `.github/​scripts/​generate-release-contributors.sh` | Queries contributors from the relevant stream. | | `.github/​renovate.json5` | Enables Renovate on both development branches. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.

[General] Routing every `release/v2.N.x` run to `2.x` makes the later unconditional API-baseline and README updates regress branch state when an older maintained minor publishes a patch after a newer 2.x minor. For example, releasing 2.33.1 after 2.34.0 would change the 2.x baseline and download link back to 2.33.1. Keep synchronizing the changelog, but only update the baseline, generated API diff, and download link when the released version is newer than the version already recorded on `2.x`.

[General] `PRIOR_VERSION` is not always the immediately preceding release: minor releases hard-code patch zero, and major releases select the highest minor but also hard-code patch zero. Since this repository publishes patches such as 2.28.1, the next minor/major release can generate contributors from an older tag and run the API audit against the wrong baseline. Select the highest full version recorded for the preceding minor/major.

[General] The newly supported 2.x notes path still computes its default range from `v<major>.<previous-minor>.0` in `.github/scripts/draft-release-notes/fetch.py:161-182`. If the preceding minor had a patch release (as many entries in this changelog do), drafting the next 2.x minor includes those already released patch commits again. Make the range resolver select the highest patch of the preceding minor before enabling this workflow for `2.x`.

Support further 2.x minor releases from a long-lived `2.x` development branch while `main` develops 3.x.

Select `2.x` in **Prepare release branch** to prepare `release/v2.33.x` and advance `2.x` to `2.34.0-SNAPSHOT`. Release notes and post-release changelog/API updates target the same development branch. The `2.x` README keeps a released 2.x download link, and a 2.x release cannot replace an existing 3.x release as GitHub's latest.

CI and Renovate cover both development branches, including branch-local license-report updates. SDK backports and 2.x snapshots remain manual; no schedules are added.

Requires the policies in [open-telemetry/admin#951](https://github.com/open-telemetry/admin/pull/951), followed by separate initialization of `2.x` from a reviewed 2.x commit. Backport the release tooling to any existing per-minor branch that will keep publishing 2.x releases.
metadata.title: Support further minor releases from a 2.x development branch
